name: GitHub software factory
description: Turn issues into independently tested and reviewed changes using isolated Docker roles and guarded automatic merge.

github.message: Reads issues and code, publishes implementation branches and reviews, and merges accepted pull requests.

exampleImplementation: Four scheduled Docker bundles perform triage, implementation, independent acceptance review, and guarded merge. A repository gateway gives each role only its required GitHub operations. Review failures return to development; passing exact-commit evidence lets the watchdog merge.

setup.message: Set up a Docker-isolated GitHub software factory. Establish the target repository, acceptance scope, and automatic merge authorization; configure four role grants and scheduled bundles using the github-software-factory skill. Target repository: {{form.repository}}. Acceptance scope: {{form.scope}}.

repository.label: Repository
repository.help: The repository whose issues will be developed and reviewed.

scope.label: Acceptance scope
scope.help: The observable outcome the factory should deliver.
